text: Prijsvrij Vakanties is a Dutch travel operator founded in 2010 by ICT entrepreneur Marc van Deursen; since 2021 it falls, together with D-reizen, under Prijsvrij Travel Holding. In 2014 DER Touristik, part of REWE Group, took a 50 percent stake in the company. It is a private limited company (besloten vennootschap) headquartered in 's-Hertogenbosch.
